ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.

akapity: Wild mushrooms must not be canned.
Do not add butter, ghee or other ingredients to jars in tested canning processes unless the original instructions call for them.
Tyndallization (heating several times, with breaks for the spores to germinate) is not considered fully reliable, because some spores do not germinate between heatings.
Botulinum spores are very hard to destroy at boiling-water temperatures.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for canning wild mushrooms from a checked source.
